title: Gamecraft Optimized
description: Experience Minecraft like never before with this elite optimization pack, built for high frame rates and seamless play.
body:
# 🚀 Gamecraft Optimized
### By Emperor Krishna

**Gamecraft Optimized is the definitive performance suite designed to transform your Minecraft experience. By blending elite-tier optimization with breathtaking visual enhancements, this lightweight yet powerful modpack ensures high FPS, zero lag, and a buttery-smooth gameplay experience for every player, regardless of their hardware.**

## 🎥 Attention Content Creators

If you are featuring Gamecraft Optimized in your content, please support the project by:

Providing the Official Link: Share the [Modrinth link] in your video description.
Giving Proper Credit: Mention the modpack name and Emperor Krishna to help the community grow!

## 🌟 Key Features

⚡Extreme Performance: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and ImmediatelyFast to drastically boost frame rates and optimize chunk loading.

✨ Next-Gen Visuals: Built-in Iris Shaders support for realistic lighting, shadows, and a captivating atmosphere.

⚙️ Maximum Efficiency: Features More Culling and Entity Culling to stop your PC from rendering what you can't see, saving massive resources.

🛡️ Rock-Solid Stability: Includes Memory Leak Fix and ModernFix to eliminate crashes and stuttering during long sessions.

🛠️ Effortless Customization: Fine-tune your experience with the intuitive YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) and Cloth Config interfaces.

## 📦 The Optimization Engine

Gamecraft Optimized comes pre-configured with a curated selection of essential mods for peak efficiency:

ModsPerformance PlusSodium Extra, Reese's Sodium Options, & Concurrent Chunk Management EngineMemory & NetworkingFerriteCore, LazyDFU, & Krypton (for lag-free multiplayer)Utility & QoLZoomify (Precision Zoom), Clumps (XP management), & 3D Skin LayersVisual FixesModel Gap Fix & Enhanced Block Entities
